subject: Cannot log into portal after password reset
description: Customer attempted a password reset via email link but receives 'invalid token' error on submission. Has tried multiple browsers.

subject: Invoice #8821 shows incorrect amount after promo applied
description: Customer's invoice reflects full price despite a 20% promotional discount that was confirmed at checkout.

subject: Product delivery delayed by 2 weeks with no notification
description: Order #ORD-55921 was promised in 5 business days but is now 3 weeks overdue. Customer has not received any status updates.

subject: WhatsApp messages not syncing to account history
description: Inbound WhatsApp conversations from the past 48 hours are not appearing in the customer account timeline.

subject: Request to add bulk CSV import for contacts
description: Customer would like the ability to import up to 10,000 contacts at once via CSV upload rather than manual entry.

subject: Two-factor authentication code not arriving via SMS
description: After enabling 2FA, customer reports the SMS verification code never arrives. Email fallback also unresponsive.

subject: Duplicate charges on subscription renewal
description: Customer was charged twice on their monthly subscription renewal on Jan 14. Requests refund for duplicate transaction.

subject: Shipment tracking link returns 404 error
description: The tracking link provided in the shipping confirmation email leads to a 404 page on the carrier website.

subject: API rate limit exceeded unexpectedly on free tier
description: Customer's integration is hitting 429 errors even though their usage dashboard shows only 40% of monthly quota consumed.

subject: Request for dedicated account manager
description: Enterprise customer wants a named account manager for faster escalation paths and quarterly business reviews.

subject: Report export to PDF missing last page of data
description: When exporting the monthly summary report to PDF, the last page (rows 201-230) is consistently missing from the output.

subject: Tax exemption certificate not applied to account
description: Customer submitted a tax exemption certificate 3 weeks ago but invoices still include sales tax. Awaiting confirmation of certificate receipt.

subject: Wrong item shipped - received blue instead of red
description: Customer ordered Product SKU-RED-42 but received SKU-BLUE-42. Awaiting customer to confirm return shipping details.

subject: SSO integration failing with Okta after configuration update
description: After a recent Okta policy change, SAML assertions are being rejected. Waiting on customer to share updated metadata XML.

subject: Clarification needed on enterprise contract renewal terms
description: Customer has questions about auto-renewal clauses and price lock provisions in their upcoming contract. Awaiting legal team sign-off before responding.

subject: Password reset email not received
description: Customer requested a password reset email but never received it. Confirmed spam folder checked. Issue resolved after whitelist added.

subject: Refund for cancelled order not processed
description: Order #ORD-44201 was cancelled within the cancellation window but the refund has not been credited after 10 business days.

subject: Parcel delivered to wrong address
description: Customer received a delivery confirmation but the package was left at a neighbour's address. Resolved after customer collected it.

subject: Dashboard widgets not loading on Firefox
description: Customer reports all dashboard widgets display a spinner indefinitely on Firefox 118. Works fine on Chrome. Fixed after browser cache cleared.

subject: Overcharged on annual plan upgrade
description: Customer upgraded mid-cycle and was charged for a full year instead of a prorated amount. Credit applied to account.

subject: Mobile app crashing on iOS 17 after update
description: App crashes on launch for iOS 17 users after v3.2.1 update. Hotfix deployed and issue resolved.

subject: Discount code expired before customer could use it
description: Promo code SAVE20 expired 2 hours before customer attempted to apply it. One-time courtesy extension granted.

subject: Data export contains corrupted rows
description: CSV export of customer records includes garbled UTF-8 characters in the address fields for non-ASCII names. Fixed in export pipeline.

subject: Shipment insurance claim not acknowledged
description: Customer filed an insurance claim for damaged goods on Nov 1. Carrier acknowledged receipt and issued settlement.

subject: Account locked after too many failed login attempts
description: Customer accidentally locked their account after 10 failed attempts. Account unlocked and temporary password issued.

subject: Invoice sent to outdated billing email
description: Invoices were being sent to a former employee's email after the billing contact was not updated. Billing contact corrected.

subject: Webhook not firing on order completion event
description: Customer's webhook endpoint was not receiving POST callbacks on order completion. Root cause: endpoint URL had trailing slash mismatch. Fixed.

subject: Missing items in partial shipment with no explanation
description: Order split into two shipments but second shipment never dispatched. Issue escalated to warehouse team; remaining items shipped.

subject: Bulk email campaign sent to unsubscribed contacts
description: A segment bug caused 140 unsubscribed contacts to receive a promotional email. Apology emails sent and suppression list updated.

subject: Currency conversion rate incorrect on checkout
description: EUR to USD conversion displayed at 1.02 instead of 1.09 during a 3-hour window on Nov 13. Affected orders refunded the difference.

subject: User permissions not saving after admin update
description: Admins reported that role changes for sub-users revert after page refresh. Bug confirmed and patch deployed.

subject: Customs clearance delay caused by incorrect HS code
description: Shipment held in customs because the HS code on the export manifest was incorrect. Corrected documentation submitted and shipment released.

subject: Notification emails going to spam folder
description: Transactional emails landing in spam for a G Suite domain. SPF and DKIM records corrected; delivery confirmed.

subject: Subscription plan showing wrong feature set
description: Business tier features (advanced analytics, API access) were not visible to customer despite confirmed upgrade. Cache issue resolved.

subject: Fragile items damaged due to inadequate packaging
description: Customer received glassware with two broken pieces due to insufficient bubble wrap. Replacement sent with improved packaging.

subject: Request for feature already available in settings
description: Customer requested a custom date-range filter that already exists under Advanced Settings. Guided via documentation. No action required.

subject: Complaint about pricing compared to competitor
description: Customer submitted a formal complaint that our pricing is higher than Competitor X. Pricing team reviewed and no adjustment approved.

subject: Refund request outside 30-day return window
description: Customer requested a refund on a purchase made 68 days ago, outside the standard 30-day policy. Request rejected per policy.

subject: Request to waive late payment fee
description: Customer requested waiver of $25 late fee citing bank processing delay. Request reviewed and rejected per standard terms.

subject: Request to export data not covered by current plan
description: Customer requested bulk historical data export (>2 years) which requires the Enterprise tier. Upgrade offer sent; customer declined.

subject: Complaint about support response time
description: Customer filed a complaint that initial response exceeded 48 hours. Internal review confirmed SLA adherence was within policy. Feedback noted.

subject: Request to grandfather old pricing after plan discontinuation
description: Customer requested to retain legacy pricing after the legacy plan was officially discontinued. Request not eligible per EOL policy.

subject: Chargeback dispute for a legitimately processed payment
description: Customer initiated a chargeback claiming they did not authorise a payment. Transaction logs confirmed customer consent. Bank ruled in our favour.

subject: Second ticket for same login issue already resolved in CF-1016
description: Customer opened a second case for the same password reset email problem that was already resolved in CF-1016. Marked as duplicate.

subject: Duplicate billing complaint for CF-1020
description: Customer submitted a second complaint about the annual plan overcharge already being handled in CF-1020. Closed as duplicate.

subject: Repeat crash report already tracked in CF-1021
description: Another iOS 17 crash report filed by a different user for the same bug tracked in CF-1021. Duplicate closed; hotfix already deployed.

subject: Duplicate webhook issue report already in CF-1027
description: Second customer reports missing webhook callbacks, same root cause as CF-1027. Fix already deployed. Closed as duplicate.

subject: Same spam email complaint already filed by colleague
description: Second team member at Magnum Holdings reports the same spam folder delivery issue already resolved in CF-1033. Closed as duplicate.

subject: Duplicate subscription feature display issue from CF-1034
description: A second user at Velocity Apps reports the same Business tier feature visibility issue resolved in CF-1034. Cache fix already deployed.

subject: Repeat currency conversion complaint already handled in CF-1030
description: Customer submits a follow-up case about the EUR/USD rate discrepancy already resolved and refunded in CF-1030. Closed as duplicate.
